instruction.text: Trinh hält eine Präsentation über die Geschichte von Basketball. Schaue dir die Präsentation an und höre aufmerksam zu.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '85%'>Basketball was invented in 1891 in Springfield, Massachusetts by the Canadian sports teacher James Naismith. <break time='1000ms'/>He created basketball as a sport that is less dangerous than American football... <break time='1000ms'/>He hoped that the players would suffer less injuries.</prosody>

hint.text:
to invent sth. – etwas erfinden
to suffer an injury – eine Verletzung erleiden

Tippe den Lautsprecher unter dem Bild an, wenn du den Text noch einmal hören willst.
hint.sound: to invent something <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet etwas erfinden.</voice> to suffer an injury<voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet eine Verletzung erleiden.</voice><voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Tippe den Lautsprecher unter dem Bild an, wenn du den Text noch einmal hören willst.</voice>

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '85%'>At first, it was played in two teams of 9 people each. <break time='1000ms'/>The players could score by throwing a soccer ball into a peach basket. <break time='1000ms'/>But it was difficult to get the ball out of the basket. <break time='1000ms'/>A few years later, they put a little hole into the bottom of the basket, to remove the balls more easily.</prosody>

hint.sound: to score <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet ein Tor oder Punkte erzielen.</voice> peach basket <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Pfirsichkorb.</voice> gym <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Sporthalle.</voice> hole <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Loch.</voice>

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '85%'>In 1894, the soccer ball got replaced by an early version of a basketball. <break time='1000ms'/>In 1898, the first professional league was founded. <break time='1000ms'/>In 1906, the peach baskets were replaced by metal hoops and nets, as well as backboards.</prosody>

hint.text:
to get replaced by sth. – durch etwas ersetzt werden
league – Liga
championship – Meisterschaft
metal hoop and net – Ring und Netz aus Metall (Basketballkorb)
backboard – Brett hinter dem Korb
hint.sound: to get replaced by something <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet durch etwas ersetzt werden.</voice> league <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Liga.</voice> championship <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Meisterschaft.</voice> metal hoop and net <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bedeutet Ring und Netz aus Metall und beschreibt einen Basketballkorb.</voice> backboard <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>beschreibt das Brett hinter einem Basketballkorb.</voice>

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '85%'>In 1932, the International Basketball Federation, FIBA, was formed. <break time='1000ms'/>In 1936, basketball became an Olympic discipline and was part of the Summer Olympic Games in Berlin.</prosody>

ssml: <prosody rate = '85%'>In 1946, the National Basketball Association, NBA, was founded in the USA. <break time='1000ms'/>The NBA has different rules than FIBA. <break time='1000ms'/>For example: The court size is bigger and the quarters are 12 minutes long.</prosody>

hint.sound: quarter <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>bezeichnet ein Viertel der Spielzeit.</voice>

atoms.b: James Naismith created basketball as a sport that is ((++less more)) dangerous than American football.
At first, basketball was played with a ((++soccer_ball tennis_ball)).
In ((++1894 2018)), the soccer ball was replaced by a basketball.
In 1936, basketball became part of the ((++Olympic_Games Highland_Games)).
The NBA was founded in the USA and has different rules than ((++FIBA BAFI)).

atoms.a: Rollstuhlbasketball wurde 1946 in den USA erfunden. Nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg wollten einige Männer wieder Basketball spielen.
atoms.b: Wheelchair basketball was ((++invented invested)) in the ((++USA USB)) in 1946. After the Second World War, some men wanted to play basketball again.

atoms.a: Viele von ihnen waren nach dem Krieg jedoch stark verletzt. Deshalb konnten sie nicht mit unverletzten Spielern mithalten. Deshalb wurde Rollstuhlbasketball erfunden.
atoms.b: However, a lot were heavily ((++injured bored)) after the war. That's why they weren't able to keep up with non-injured players. That's how ((++wheelchair_basketball wheeltable_basketball)) was invented.

atoms.a: Es hat dieselben Regeln wie regulärer Basketball. Der Hauptunterschied ist, dass alle Spieler in einem Rollstuhl sitzen müssen. Deshalb dürfen die Spieler auch nicht den Boden mit den Füßen berühren.
atoms.b: It has the ((++same different)) rules as regular basketball. The main difference is that the players all have to sit in a wheelchair. That's why players aren't allowed to touch the floor with their ((++feet hands)).

atoms.a: Rollstuhlbasketball ist eine Disziplin bei den Paralympischen Spielen.
atoms.b: Wheelchair basketball is a discipline at the ((++Paralympic Olympic)) Games.
